recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four women emerging from a dense, swirling mist or water, set against a dramatic, cloudy purple and blue twilight sky. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a dreamlike, painterly quality with heavy atmospheric perspective.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects integrated into the environment via mist overlays
High-contrast relationship between dark skin tones and bright white mist
Vertical hierarchy with large stylized text at the top and subjects centered below
Monochromatic purple-blue sky contrasting with warm skin undertones
coreInvariants: Heavy atmospheric fog/mist obscuring the lower half of the subjects
Dramatic, textured cloudscape in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the center, waist-up, filling the middle two-quarters of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central two figures provide the primary focal point, framed by the outer two.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and settles into the swirling mist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky and lower mist provide significant breathing room for the central subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep violet and indigo sky providing the mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale lavender mist in the foreground.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm brown and amber tones in the subjects' skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the mist and the dark sky.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy, italicized script with exaggerated flourishes
Secondary text is a clean, condensed sans-serif
Heavy 3D beveling and drop shadows applied to the script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on initial and terminal letters of the script
Metallic chrome-like texture applied to the letter faces
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a complex, textured script with a minimalist, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, calligraphic energy of the main title.
Provides the necessary clean, vertical contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus photograph of four women with dark skin and natural hair, waist-up, emerging from a thick layer of white swirling mist. The background is a dramatic twilight sky with heavy purple and blue clouds. The lighting is moody and ethereal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a beveled, metallic script font at the top. Below it, add a subtitle in a small, white, condensed sans-serif font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the mist obscuring the lower bodies naturally?
Does the script text have a visible 3D bevel effect?
Is the color palette dominated by purple and blue?
Are the faces of the subjects clear despite the soft focus?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple sky hue
Number of subjects in the group
Metallic texture of the primary font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subjects into the mist
avoid: Hard edges between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the bevel on the text looks metallic and not plastic.
Verify the sky maintains a deep, moody purple tone.
Confirm the subtitle is centered and legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ethereal Atmosphere + Group Portrait + Beveled Script Typography + Purple/Blue Palette
